Final for Publication

NARRATIVE
TYPE 1 REZONING AMENDMENT
3707 W. MCLEAN AVE
FROM RS-3 TO RT-4

The subject property is improved with a 4-unit residential building, likely constructed in the
early 1900s. When selling the propetty, the prior owner marketed the building as a 4-unit building.
The current owner purchased the building in 2018 and desires to re-zone the property so that the
zoning conforms to the actual use of the building as a 4-unit residential building. Although the lot is
zoned RS-3, the building has characteristics associated with the RT-4 zoning district. The owner of
the building also owns the vacant lot to the west, 3709 W. McLean, which is zoned RS-3.

There will be no changes to the current physical structure of the building. As shown on the
accompanying plans, there are currently four units which provide naturally occurring affordable
housing. The layout of the building, which will not change, is as follows:

First floor: one 3-bedroom unit. 1,295 sq. ft.
Second floor one 2-bedroon unit and one 1-bedroom unit. 1,214 sq. ft.
Third floor: one 1-bedroom unit. 1,214 sq. ft.

Total Floor Area: 3,723

The following are the relevant information of the existing building:

Height: 3 story - 32 feet, 6 inches.

Lot size: 3,130 sq. ft (25 feet x 125.2 feet), interior lot.
Residential Units: 4

Allowable Floor Area: 3,756 (1.2 FAR x 3,130 sq. ft.)
